nodes.label: StateEngine Class
nodes.rationale: State machine using time.monotonic() deltas exclusively to replace constant-duration event accumulation that caused active_seconds to exceed session_elapsed_seconds

nodes.label: ActivityState Enum
nodes.rationale: Four states (ACTIVE, IDLE, LOCKED, SLEEP) replace boolean is_active/is_locked flags

nodes.label: Monotonic Clock Timing
nodes.rationale: time.monotonic() is immune to NTP, manual clock changes, and timezone switches — unlike time.time() which caused phantom sleep gaps and counter resets (Bug 2)

nodes.label: Server-Side Ingest Duration Validation
nodes.rationale: Defence-in-depth layer — clamps per-event to 86400s and scales batch total to 86400s to protect database even if client bug sends bad data

nodes.label: Startup Gap 86400s Cap
nodes.rationale: Multi-day shutdown gap created a single 259200s event in one partition; capping at 86400s prevents screen_off > 24h on dashboard (Bug 4)

nodes.label: Active Time Session Invariant
nodes.rationale: active_seconds <= session_elapsed_seconds enforced via proportional scaling before every cache write (Bug 3)

nodes.label: Measured Event Duration
nodes.rationale: Replaced hardcoded LOG_INTERVAL (30s) with int(elapsed_since_log) from real monotonic clock delta (Bug 1)
